name: Megadeath Moromi
source:
Megadeath Moromi is a veteran member of Ice Flame and like much of its members is not a magic-user, making her part of the mistreated 2nd class citizens of Zeth.

[spoiler]She was originally a part of Sanakia Drelshkaf's Silver Corps, but was eventually approached by Rance who was trying to convince her to join his Green Corps. Since her friend and crush, the cute nurse [url=/c98816]Prima Hononoman[/url] is already part of the Green Squad, she gladly accepts.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Megadeath_Moromi]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
